title: Mixed Berry Frozen Yoghurt
changes_from_base: A sieved strawberry and raspberry purée is whisked into the strained yoghurt with a little extra sugar, turning it pink and fruity.
summary: Strained yoghurt whisked with a sieved strawberry and raspberry purée, churned into pink swirls and scattered with fresh berries.
equipment: sieve lined with a triple layer of muslin
piping bag with large star nozzle (optional)

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Strain the yoghurt
steps.text: Drain the yoghurt in the muslin-lined sieve over a bowl, covered, in the fridge for 8-12 h until about 300 ml of whey has run off. Discard the whey.

steps.title: Make the purée
steps.text: Blend the strawberries and raspberries until smooth, then press through the fine sieve to remove the seeds.

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: Whisk the strained yoghurt with the purée, sugar, golden syrup and salt for 2-3 min until evenly pink and the sugar has dissolved. The extra sugar balances the sharp fruit and keeps it soft.

steps.title: Churn
steps.text: Churn for 20-30 min, until the mixture holds soft swirls.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Pipe tall swirls into bowls and scatter the raspberries and blueberries around. For firmer scoops, freeze for up to 2 h first.

tips: Sieve the purée well; seeds feel gritty when frozen.
Frozen berries, thawed, work for the purée.
Taste before churning: the mixture should taste slightly too sweet, as cold dulls sweetness.
storage: Best eaten on the day. Keep leftovers frozen and covered for up to 1 week.
